They hold hands and smile while posing for the camera. (2) A medium shot focuses on the man. He stands centrally, wearing a black cross-body bag over his jacket. He looks slightly off-camera then shifts his gaze back. The background remains the bright architectural facade under a clear blue sky. (3) A medium close-up transitions to the woman. (4) The camera cuts back to a medium shot of the man. His expression has changed to one of slight exhaustion or blinking confusion, contrasting his earlier smile. He stands still as text overlays appear beside him. (5) A final shot shows the man looking directly into the camera with a neutral, somewhat weary expression. Large blocks of text are centered over the frame, obscuring most of the background architecture as the video concludes.
